The Chinese zodiac consists of 12 animals that cycle through each year starting on Chinese New Year. The order of the animals is said to be from the order they completed a race. The animal year when you were born is said to say something about your personality and have different compatibility with certain animal years. 


| Number | Animal     |
| ------ | ---------- |
| 1      | Rat        |
| 2      | Ox         |
| 3      | Tiger      |
| 4      | Rabbit     |
| 5      | Dragon     |
| 6      | Snake      |
| 7      | Horse      |
| 8      | Sheep/Goat |
| 9      | Monkey     |
| 10     | Rooster    |
| 11     | Dog        |
| 12     | Pig/Boar   |
